title: Kwalitatieve analyse: kunst én kunde - dataset bron 05. “A guide to the credit crunch”
descriptions: Formaat: MP3 Omvang: 2,9 Mb Creator: Robert Peston Online beschikbaar: [01-12-2014] Samenvatting: Audio Slideshow: A guide to the credit crunch. It seems as though the term 'credit crunch' is becoming common parlance. But do you know what it actually is - or how it came about? Spend a few minutes with the BBC's Business Editor Robert Peston, as he explains why we are in the middle of a global financial crisis.
